title: Resistencia
goal: Read how resistance to repression took many forms -- human rights organizations, Pérez Esquivel's 1980 Nobel Peace Prize, cultural resistance, and international solidarity, alongside a smaller armed resistance.
grammar: Cabe destacar que: señalar un dato importante

items: Describe what the Vicaría de la Solidaridad did in Chile.
Explain why Pérez Esquivel won the 1980 Nobel Peace Prize.
Describe the "nueva canción" movement's role in resistance.
Explain why armed resistance was generally a minority path.
Use cabe destacar que to flag an important fact.
